sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-4 on the Volve field in the Norwegian North Sea.
No field data tools were available when this review was written, so no operational figures are stated here.
Hole sizes, section depths, rates, activity hours, lost time and dates are therefore omitted rather than estimated from memory.
The section-by-section hole sizes, start and end depths, casing shoe depths and drilling rates for 15/9-F-4 must be taken from the wellbore's drilling data before this section can be completed.
Total activity time, lost time by tier and code, and the share of lost time per section must be computed from the activity log for 15/9-F-4.
No statement about non-productive time or its causes is made in this draft.

The first and last report dates, the completion date, the number of active reporting days and the drilling campaigns with their operation phases need to be confirmed against the daily report records for 15/9-F-4.
Populate the hole-section table, depth progression, time breakdown and campaign summary from source data.
Check every quantity and date in the final text against the source records before the review is issued.
